title.zh: 三视图 · 三张影子拼回立体
title.en: Three Views · Three Shadows Rebuild a Solid

desc.zh: 把积木从正面、侧面、上面各看一眼，得到三张平面图；三张图对齐起来，就能还原出立体的样子。
desc.en: Look at a stack of blocks from the front, the left and above to get three flat pictures; line them up and you can rebuild the solid.

legacyLayout._note: Whitespace and markup of the hand-written lesson this page was converted from, so the conversion could be checked byte for byte (specs/site-template.md §3c).
